page.overview:
Who is Fu Manchu?

Fu Manchu is an immortal master criminal based in China. His son Shang-Chi wages a long war against him.

Fu Manchu achieved immortality because a serum called the Elixir Vitae. For forty years he was opposed by Sir Denis Nayland Smith and his colleague Petrie. But Shang-Chi knew nothing of this as he was raised by his father, who pretended to be a noble man dedicated to world peace. He then ordered Shang-Chi to kill Petrie. Shang-Chi believed he had done so (though it was only a replicant) but this brought him into contact with Nayland Smith who told him the truth of his father. Shang-Chi joined with Nayland Smith, Petrie, Black Jack Tarr an ex soldier and Clive Reston, a smooth talker in the war against Fu Manchu.
